Lawyer husband to pay ₹1.1 crore to advocate wife and daughter after divorce, Uttarakhand HC

The Uttarakhand High Court has upheld a divorce granted to a lawyer husband on the ground of mental cruelty, while directing him to pay ₹40 lakh as permanent alimony to his wife and ₹70 lakh for their minor daughter’s welfare and education.
comment: Beyond the quantum of alimony, such cases also highlight the need for clearer financial planning during marriage, especially around children's long-term security and post-divorce obligations.
